title: Bare Bones x Snuffles
description: Bare Bones textures for Snuffles mod !
body:
This resource pack adds Bare Bones textures to [Snuffles](https://modrinth.com/mod/snuffles-fabric) mod !

- This resource pack is contained in [Bare Bones x Mods](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones-x-mods) ! It's a more convenient way to use my Bare Bones compatibility packs
